originalTitle: Alphafold involved in a SOTA C02 direct air capture method by mid 2026 ?
title: AlphaFold 是否参与领先的空气碳捕集方法？
Would AlphaFold contribute to a leading direct-air-capture method?
rules: 原题关注 2026 年中前的 AlphaFold 或其后继技术参与；平台已判定 No。
The question concerns AlphaFold or a successor contributing before mid-2026; the platform resolved No.
interpretation: 原描述对“领先方法”的量化定义有限；这不是 MOF 专用市场，也不能从这次判定推出蛋白质路线没有研究价值。
The description gives limited quantitative meaning to leading performance. This is not MOF-specific, and settlement does not rule out protein-based research.

summary: 预测 AlphaFold 或后继技术是否参与领先的空气捕集方法，已判 No；不是判断酶能不能捕集 CO₂。
Resolved No on AlphaFold involvement in a leading DAC method, not on whether enzymes can capture CO₂.
checklist: 找到模型实际用于哪一步设计的可核验记录。
Identify documented model use in a specific design step.
查空气 CO₂ 条件和完整过程表现，不能以烟气实验替代。
Check atmospheric-CO₂ conditions and full-process performance, rather than flue-gas results.
原规则的“领先”口径有限，比较效率必须回到原条件。
The source’s leading-method definition is limited; compare performance under explicit conditions.

stage: 结构工具 → 酶材料 → 工业过程 → 空气移除
Structure tool → enzyme material → process → DAC
impact: Saipem 的酶法工业捕集资料使“酶有无工程用途”变得具体。它并不能证明 AlphaFold 参与其中；工业烟气与空气的 CO₂ 浓度也不同。因此企业产品不能替原题补上算法参与和领先 DAC 两个条件。

Saipem makes industrial enzyme capture concrete, but does not establish AlphaFold use. Industrial emissions and air also differ. A product cannot fill the model-involvement and leading-DAC conditions by implication.
gap: 要影响本题判定，需要明确的软件使用、空气工况及可比较过程表现。当前引用资料未把这些条件连接成同一条已证实的项目链。
Contract-relevant evidence would connect documented model use, atmospheric feed and comparable process performance in one project; the cited sources do not do so.

title: AlphaFold、酶催化和空气捕集之间有多道验证
Several validation steps separate AlphaFold, enzymes and direct air capture
principle: 碳酸酐酶可加速 CO₂ 与水、碳酸氢根之间的转化：CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + H⁺。加速反应不等于改变平衡，也不自动给出净捕集量。蛋白结构预测能帮助设计实验，但不能代替催化效率、寿命及再生能耗测量。

Carbonic anhydrase accelerates CO₂ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + H⁺. Faster kinetics do not by themselves establish net capture. Structure prediction can guide experiments but does not replace activity, lifetime and regeneration-energy measurements.
example: Sandia 等机构的酶膜研究是真实的分离工作，但不能因此称其使用了 AlphaFold，也不能把烟气条件下的 CO₂ 分离直接等同于从空气净移除。本题还额外要求算法参与及“领先方法”的判定依据。

The enzyme-membrane paper is real separation research, but does not thereby establish AlphaFold use or net atmospheric removal. This contract additionally needs evidence of model involvement and a definition of a leading method.
